reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 25874387, Tangent's documented market contracts reported $4,630,952.96 of borrower collateral at each market's own oracle price. Decomposing the active frxUSD/sUSDS, frxUSD/sDOLA, frxUSD/scrvUSD, and frxUSD/OUSD Curve LP balances at their stored rates attributes $480,640.43, or 10.3789%, to frxUSD. The remaining 89.6211% stays aggregated because a complete tracked-asset look-through review was outside this correction; the separately documented USG/frxUSD Peg Keeper is a stabilization counterparty and is not counted as borrower collateral.
